title: Handi-Quacks
description: One day, three ducks were crossing the road going to get some soda, but they weren’t looking where they were going and a bus came along and hit them all. Now they’re handicapped and that’s pretty much it!
quote: Our palms are slippery and sweaty because of the heat from that new wood stove we just bought.
creator: Peter Griffin
altHero: scribbly hand-drawn picture of a city and three ducks: blue, purple, and yellow
alt2: the handi-quacks getting hit by a bus
alt3: the handi-quacks injured on the road
alt4: the handi-quacks, now disabled, in their home playing cards next to a wood stove
